findings.evidence: The same overclaim appears in `FundamentalDomain.lean:19–24`: “the only such homomorphism” and “the theorem would have no `φ`”; an arbitrary `φ : G →* P` need not send a negative-determinant matrix to its usual fractional-linear transformation.
findings.fix: State specifically that `ratPosToPSL2R`, the intended standard fractional-linear homomorphism, has source `GL(2, ℚ)⁺`; avoid claiming no other homomorphism exists. Make the same correction in `FundamentalDomain.lean`.
findings.issue: The section documentation claims the only homomorphism into `PSL(2, ℝ)` is defined on `GL(2, ℚ)⁺`; this is literally false (for example, a trivial homomorphism exists), and the lower-half-plane argument applies only to the standard fractional-linear map.

summary: The new explanatory documentation overstates why the source group must have positive determinant.
